exposure: accelerated fetal growth in early pregnancy (accelerated biparietal diameter growth > 90th centile)
cohort: The study included 69,617 singleton pregnancies without congenital malformations, with available biometric measurements during the first and second trimesters.
finding: Fetuses with accelerated biparietal diameter (BPD) growth in early pregnancy exhibited increased odds of overall prematurity and medically induced preterm birth.
gest_age: Preterm birth defined as occurring before 37 completed weeks of gestation, further stratified into very preterm birth (before 32 weeks) and moderate preterm birth (between 32 and 37 weeks).
